summary: Self-named off-registry HTTP dependency delivers unpinned code from repo.remoteknight.com
details: package.json declares a dependency whose key equals the package's own name (@bx-ui-framework/authentication) and whose value is a bare HTTPS URL, https://repo.remoteknight.com/bx-ui-framework/authentication, instead of a semver range against the npm registry. On npm install this URL is fetched and installed as the resolved package, executing any lifecycle scripts contained in the returned tarball, with no version pin and no integrity check. The shipped index.js is an inert stub, so the off-registry URL is the actual delivery channel for whatever code ends up on the installer's machine. The self-named dependency shape also matches dependency-confusion tactics, causing downstream builds that resolve @bx-ui-framework/authentication to pull code from repo.remoteknight.com rather than the registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
